Asset type: premium 16:9 full-screen illustrated diplomacy background for the game Besieged in Constantinople, 1452. Generate a richly detailed, realistic historical oil painting with lifelike faces, believable anatomy, crisp materials and warm late-afternoon Adriatic light, coherent with luxurious midnight-blue and aged-gold Byzantine strategy game art.

A lofty late-medieval Ragusan Gothic loggia overlooking Dubrovnik's old harbour and blue sea, pale limestone pointed arches, carved balustrade, distant red-tile roofs and modest fortified harbour walls with sailing merchant vessels. Historically plausible mid-fifteenth century atmosphere, no modern architecture or giant Baroque landmarks. Patterned stone paving and a few restrained dark blue, burgundy and gold textiles.

Exactly TWO principal men, both entirely contained in the LEFT 60% of the picture, clearly separate silhouettes. In the near left foreground at about x=25%: Johannes Gazulus, a mature scholar and diplomat in his early sixties, clean-shaven narrow thoughtful face, grey short rounded clerical hair with subtle tonsure, dark charcoal clerical scholar's robe, restrained gold-edged stole, seated behind an elegant low inlaid wooden chess table. No readable writing. His expression is intelligent, patient and gently sardonic. Show his head, shoulders, torso, and steepled hands unobscured above the table.
Further behind him at x=49%, by the marble pier of a window: Benedetto Cotrugli, merchant aged about 35, handsome but not glamorous, dark chestnut hair and short neatly trimmed beard, dark burgundy wool merchant's robe over midnight-navy clothing, soft dark burgundy Italian cap. He stands relaxed with one hand on the balustrade, looking toward the viewer; his outline is distinct and clickable. His lower legs can be partly hidden by the balustrade.

Composition is essential: rightmost 38% is a beautiful naturally quieter empty architectural bay and distant sea, intended for overlay controls later. No men or important chess objects may extend into that area. Do NOT paint a UI, dark rectangle, frame, menu, lettering, labels or symbols there. The entire image must remain a finished luminous painting, with visual activity and both men concentrated on the left. No additional foreground characters. Painted depth, realistic soft shadows, appealing warm stone and cool blue water. Invented artistic likenesses, not an assertion of surviving historical portraits. Wide cinematic 16:9 landscape, approximately 2048 by 1152.

The younger dark-haired short-bearded merchant in the burgundy cap and burgundy/navy robe, Benedetto Cotrugli, now occupies the seated foreground position behind the chess table (left side); he keeps his own exact face, cap and clothing, now with hands steepled thoughtfully above the board, meeting the viewer's gaze.
